title: EMPIRICAL EVALUATION OF PUBLIC HATESPEECH DATASETS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the empirical evaluation and benchmarking of various hatespeech datasets using a BERT-based baseline classifier. While it acknowledges that some datasets include 'religion' as a category for targeted hate speech (e.g., in Table 2), the study is a technical assessment of dataset quality, labeling consistency, and classification performance rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics themselves.
